sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING min(e.occurred_at) > $3::timestamptz) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING min(e.occurred_at) < $3::timestamptz) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING min(e.occurred_at) <@ tstzrange($3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, '[)')) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING min(e.occurred_at) <= $5::timestamptz) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING min(e.occurred_at) <@ tstzrange($6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, '(]')) AND p.id IN (SELECT e.person_id FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = $1 AND e.name = $2::text GROUP BY e.person_id HAVING min(e.occurred_at) <@ tstzrange($7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, '[)'))))
